title: Where is it? room photo task
subject: Arabic
unit: Summer 1: Common vocabulary: prepositions, questions and body parts
source: Seeded from arabic/y7 lesson 24 (Pupil PDF worksheet: where is it? room photo task)
intro: Lesson 24: Prepositions of place: فِي، عَلَى، تَحْتَ، فَوْقَ. To understand how four prepositions of place work and use them to say where things are

questions.q: Say: the book is on the table.
questions.model: Teacher: start with the thing: الكِتَابُ. Then where: عَلَى (on). Then the place with kasrah: الطَّاوِلَةِ.

questions.q: After فِي the noun ends in ...

Picture task on the pupil PDF (a room photo with numbered objects): write six sentences saying where each object is, with the correct kasrah. Differentiated: Group A uses the word bank; Group B writes without it.
questions.a: Six correct sentences, for example: السَّاعَةُ فَوْقَ البَابِ؛ القِطَّةُ تَحْتَ الطَّاوِلَةِ
questions.model: Teacher does object 1: القَلَمُ عَلَى الكِتَابِ, underlining the kasrah on الكِتَابِ.

questions.q: write 'the Qur'an is on the shelf (الرَّفّ)'.
Back to our ponder: عَلَى or فَوْقَ?
